## About
D & J Enterprises is a lighting and electrical specialist in Denver. We work for homeowners, apartment buildings and commercial clients, doing repairs, installations and build outs.
Don owns the company, and Sam is the installer you'll read about in our reviews. Every employee is licensed and certified, with years of experience.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 90 reviews, and we'd be glad to help with your next project.

## Services
- Lighting Sales / Repairs & Installation: Lighting sales, repairs and installation for homes and commercial buildings.
- Ceiling Fan installation: Our specialty. Old fans down, new ones up, installed clean with no wobbles or squeaks, as one customer put it.
- Bathroom fan installations: Bathroom fan installations for homeowners.
- Attic Fan installations: Attic fan installations for homeowners.
- Under Cabinet Lighting: Under cabinet lighting for kitchens and work areas.
- Chandelier & Pendant Lighting: Chandelier and pendant lighting hung and wired properly.
- Cable & Phone lines / Low voltage: Cable, phone lines and other low voltage work.
- Electric Car Charger Installation: Electric car charger installation for your home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We work for residential and commercial clients, including apartment buildings.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Give us a call or send a brief message about what you need, and we'll get back to you.
